property_summary: For any payer address, sending exactly C.TICKET_AMOUNT to play() always succeeds on the reference and increases the contract balance by that amount (the mutant that requires TICKET_AMOUNT+1 will revert for that input), so the universal rule is: play() accepts payments == C.TICKET_AMOUNT and increases address(c).balance accordingly; the mutant breaks this for some inputs (payer sending TICKET_AMOUNT).
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from TICKET_AMOUNT to TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 so play can accept a different payment and thus affect pot updates.
